1.text: Umuseke utambitse, abatambyi bakuru bose n'abakuru b'ubwo bwoko bigīra inama yo kwica Yesu.

3.text: Maze Yuda wamugambaniye abonye ko urubanza rutsinze Yesu, aricuza asubiza abatambyi bakuru n'abakuru bya bice by'ifeza mirongo itatu ati

4.text: “Nakoze icyaha, kuko nagambaniye amaraso atariho urubanza.”Ariko bo baramusubiza bati “Biramaze! Ni ibyawe.”

5.text: Ifeza azijugunya mu rusengero arasohoka, aragenda arimanika.

6.text: Ariko abatambyi bakuru bajyana bya bice by'ifeza baravuga bati “Amategeko ntiyemera ko tubishyira mu bubiko bw'Imana, kuko ari ibiguzi by'amaraso.”

7.text: Bajya inama bazigura isambu y'umubumbyi, ngo ijye ihambwamo abashyitsi.

8.text: Ni cyo gituma iyo sambu yitwa Isambu y'amaraso na bugingo n'ubu.

9.text: Ni bwo ibyavuzwe n'umuhanuzi Yeremiya byasohoye ngo “Bajyanye ibice by'ifeza mirongo itatu, ari cyo giciro cy'uwo baciriye, uwo bamwe mu Bisirayeli baciriye,

10.text: babigura isambu y'umubumbyi nk'uko Uwiteka yanyeretse.”

11.text: Ubwo Yesu yari ahagaze imbere y'umutegeka. Umutegeka aramubaza ati “Ni wowe mwami w'Abayuda?”Yesu aramusubiza ati “Wakabimenye.”

12.text: Abatambyi bakuru n'abakuru baramurega, ariko ntiyagira icyo yireguza na hato.

13.text: Maze Pilato aramubaza ati “Ntiwumvise ko bagushinje byinshi?”

14.text: Ariko ntiyamusubiza ijambo na rimwe, bituma umutegeka yumirwa cyane.

15.text: Muri iyo minsi mikuru, uko umwaka utashye umutegeka yagiraga akamenyero ko kubohorera abantu imbohe imwe, iyo bashakaga.

16.text: Icyo gihe bari bafite imbohe y'ikimenywabose, yitwaga Baraba.

17.text: Nuko bateranye Pilato arababaza ati “Uwo mushaka ko mbabohorera ni nde? Ni Baraba, cyangwa ni Yesu witwa Kristo?”

18.text: Kuko yamenye yuko ishyari ari ryo rimubatangishije.

19.text: Kandi ubwo yari yicaye ku ntebe y'imanza, umugore we amutumaho ati “Ntugire icyo utwara uwo mukiranutsi, kuko naraye ndose byinshi kuri we byambabaje.”

20.text: Ariko abatambyi bakuru n'abakuru boshya abantu ngo basabe Baraba, bicishe Yesu.

21.text: Nuko umutegeka yongera kubabaza ati “Muri abo bombi, uwo mushaka ni nde nkamubabohorera?”Bati “Ni Baraba.”

22.text: Pilato arabasubiza ati “Yesu witwa Kristo ndamugira nte?”Bose bati “Nabambwe!”

23.text: Na we arababaza ati “Kuki? Yakoze cyaha ki?”Ariko barushaho gusakuza cyane bati “Nabambwe!”

24.text: Nuko Pilato abonye ko arushywa n'ubusa, ahubwo ko barushijeho gushega, yenda amazi akarabira imbere y'abantu ati “Jyeweho nta cyaha kindiho ku bw'amaraso y'uyu mukiranutsi, birabe ibyanyu.”

25.text: Abantu bose baramusubiza bati “Amaraso ye natubeho no ku bana bacu.”

26.text: Maze ababohorera Baraba, ariko amaze gukubita Yesu imikoba, aramutanga ngo abambwe.

27.text: Maze abasirikare b'umutegeka bajyana Yesu mu rukiko, bamuteraniranirizaho ingabo zose.

29.text: baboha ikamba ry'amahwa barimwambika mu mutwe, n'urubingo mu kuboko kwe kw'iburyo baramupfukamira, baramushinyagurira bati “Ni amahoro, mwami w'Abayuda!”

30.text: Bamucira amacandwe, benda rwa rubingo barumukubita mu mutwe.

31.text: Bamaze kumushinyagurira bamwambura wa mwenda, bamwambika imyenda ye bamujyana kumubamba.

32.text: Bagisohoka, bahura n'Umunyakurene witwaga Simoni, uwo bamuhata kujyana na bo ngo yikorere umusaraba wa Yesu.

33.text: Bageze ahitwa i Gologota, hasobanurwa ngo i Nyabihanga,

34.text: bamuha vino ivanze n'indurwe ngo anywe, asogongeye yanga kuyinywa.

35.text: Bamaze kumubamba, bagabana imyenda ye, barayifindira,

37.text: Bashyira hejuru y'umutwe we ibirego bamureze, byanditswe ngo “UYU NI YESU, UMWAMI W'ABAYUDA.”

38.text: Maze abambuzi babiri bababambana na we, umwe iburyo bwe undi ibumoso.

40.text: baravuga bati “Wowe usenya urusengero ukarwubaka mu minsi itatu, ikize. Niba uri Umwana w'Imana, manuka uve ku musaraba.”

41.text: Abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi n'abakuru na bo bashinyagura batyo bati

42.text: “Yakijije abandi, ntabasha kwikiza. Ko ari umwami w'Abisirayeli, namanuke ave ku musaraba nonaha, natwe turamwemera.

43.text: Yiringiye Imana, ngaho nimukize nonaha, niba imukunda kuko yavuze ati ‘Ndi Umwana w'Imana.’ ”

44.text: N'abambuzi babambanywe na we, na bo bamutuka batyo.

45.text: Uhereye ku isaha ya gatandatu haba ubwirakabiri mu gihugu cyose kugeza ku isaha ya cyenda.

46.text: Maze ku isaha ya cyenda Yesu avuga ijwi rirenga ati “Eli, Eli, lama sabakitani?” Bisobanurwa ngo “Mana yanjye, Mana yanjye, ni iki kikundekesheje?”

47.text: Ariko bamwe mu bari bahagaze aho babyumvise baravuga bati “Umva wa mugabo arahamagara Eliya.”

48.text: Uwo mwanya umwe muri bo arirukanka, yenda sipongo ayuzuza inzoga isharira, ayishyira ku rubingo arayimushomesha.

49.text: Ariko abandi bati “Ba uretse turebe ko Eliya aza kumukiza.”

50.text: Ariko Yesu yongera kuvuga ijwi rirenga, aratanga.

51.text: Umwenda ukingiriza Ahera cyane h'urusengero utabukamo kabiri, utangirira hejuru ugeza hasi, isi iratigita, ibitare birameneka,

52.text: ibituro birakinguka, intumbi nyinshi z'abera bari barasinziriye zirazurwa,

53.text: bava mu bituro, maze amaze kuzuka binjira mu murwa wera, babonekera benshi.

54.text: Umutware utwara umutwe w'abasirikare n'abari kumwe na we barinda Yesu, babonye igishyitsi n'ibibaye baratinya cyane bati “Ni ukuri, uyu yari Umwana w'Imana.”

55.text: Hariho n'abagore benshi bari bahagaze kure bareba, ni bo bakurikiye Yesu ava i Galilaya, baramukorera.

56.text: Muri bo harimo Mariya Magadalena, na Mariya nyina wa Yakobo na Yosefu, na nyina wa bene Zebedayo.

57.text: Nuko nimugoroba haza umuntu w'umutunzi wo muri Arimataya witwaga Yosefu, kandi na we yari umwigishwa wa Yesu.

58.text: Uwo ajya kwa Pilato asaba intumbi ya Yesu, maze Pilato ategeka ko bayimuha.

59.text: Yosefu ajyana intumbi, ayizingira mu mwenda w'igitare wera,

60.text: ayishyira mu mva ye nshya, iyo yakorogoshoye mu rutare, abirindurira igitare ku munwa w'imva, aragenda.

61.text: Mariya Magadalena na Mariya wundi bari bahari bicaye berekeye imva.

62.text: Nuko bukeye bwaho, ari wo munsi wakurikiraga uwo Kwitegura, abatambyi bakuru n'Abafarisayo bateranira kwa Pilato.

63.text: Baramubwira bati “Mutware, twibutse yuko wa mubeshyi akiri muzima yagize ngo iminsi itatu nishira azazuka.

64.text: Nuko tegeka barinde igituro cyane bazageze ku munsi wa gatatu, kugira ngo abigishwa be bataza kumwiba bakabwira abantu ngo arazutse, maze kuyoba kwa nyuma kukaruta ukwa mbere.”

65.text: Pilato arababwira ati “Ngaba abarinzi, nimugende mukirindishe uko mubizi.”

66.text: Na bo baragenda barindisha igituro, bahoma ubushishi ku gitare kugira ngo bagiteranye n'umunwa w'igituro, babushyiraho ikimenyetso abarinzi bahari.
